scope_summary: First-phase scheduling modernization covering process discovery, scheduling design, pilot backlog and enablement plan.

evidence.value: dispatch scheduling needs improvement before year end

candidate_deliverables.text: Process discovery summary for dispatch scheduling pain points and supervisor workflows.
Scheduling design options and recommended pilot workflow.
Pilot backlog and enablement plan for a later implementation phase.

candidate_acceptance_criteria.text: Supervisors say the schedule looks usable.

candidate_assumptions.text: Client will provide supervisor availability for discovery workshops.

candidate_exclusions.text: Production deployment and post-go-live support are outside this first-phase drafting scope.

prior_sow_terms.summary: Prior SOW caps provider liability at three times fees, carves data breach and confidentiality breach out of the cap, and permits indirect damages for data breach claims.
prior_sow_terms.material_difference: broader liability cap, uncapped carve-outs and indirect-damage exposure compared with approved library clause

prior_sow_terms.summary: Prior SOW provides uncapped indemnity for all data-protection losses, regulatory fines, third-party claims, investigation costs and remediation costs.
prior_sow_terms.material_difference: uncapped data-protection indemnity outside approved liability framework
